entry.name: MAV_CMD_THACO_EXTERNAL_XYZ
entry.description: THACO External XYZ marker - triggers companion to start external XYZ control

entry.name: MAV_CMD_THACO_ACTUATOR_CONTROL
entry.description: THACO Actuator Control - controls THACO actuator directly via MAVLink

entry.name: MAV_CMD_THACO_EXTERNAL_XYZ_COMPLETE
entry.description: THACO External XYZ Complete - starts asynchronous PX4-managed mission resume

entry.name: MAV_CMD_THACO_SAVE_DEFAULT_CONFIG
entry.description: Persist currently active subsystem configuration as factory / boot default
entry.param: Subsystem ID (0: All, 1: Telemetry, 2: Camera, 3: Network, 4: Vision)

entry.name: MAV_CMD_THACO_APPLY_CONFIG
entry.description: Apply staged changes and restart affected subsystem services
entry.param: Subsystem ID (0: All, 1: Telemetry, 2: Camera, 3: Network, 4: Vision)
Restart service flag (1: restart immediately, 0: apply pending)

entry.name: MAV_CMD_THACO_RESTORE_DEFAULT_CONFIG
entry.description: Revert staged or active configuration back to default baseline
entry.param: Subsystem ID (0: All, 1: Telemetry, 2: Camera, 3: Network, 4: Vision)

enum.name: CC_LINK_STATUS
enum.description: Link connection states for FC and SIYI

entry.name: CC_LINK_STATUS_DISCONNECTED
entry.description: Link is disconnected or port is unavailable

entry.name: CC_LINK_STATUS_CONNECTING
entry.description: Link is attempting connection / baudrate negotiation

entry.name: CC_LINK_STATUS_CONNECTED
entry.description: Link is active and transmitting MAVLink traffic

entry.name: CC_LINK_STATUS_ERROR
entry.description: Link experienced error, packet overrun, or loss of heartbeat

entry.name: CC_CAM_STATUS_DISCONNECTED
entry.description: No camera detected on expected bus/interface

entry.name: CC_CAM_STATUS_INITIALIZING
entry.description: Camera device detected, initializing pipeline / sensor stream

entry.name: CC_CAM_STATUS_STREAMING
entry.description: Camera is actively capturing and RTSP server is broadcasting

entry.name: CC_CAM_STATUS_ERROR
entry.description: Camera pipeline encountered critical error

enum.name: CC_CAM_ERROR
enum.description: Detailed error classification for camera subsystem

entry.name: CC_CAM_ERROR_NONE
entry.description: No error, operating normally

entry.name: CC_CAM_ERROR_NOT_FOUND
entry.description: Camera hardware device node or USB device not found

entry.name: CC_CAM_ERROR_USB_DEGRADED
entry.description: Camera connected to USB 2.0 port instead of required USB 3.0/3.2, bandwidth limited

entry.name: CC_CAM_ERROR_PIPELINE
entry.description: GStreamer / RealSense pipeline negotiation failed

entry.name: CC_CAM_ERROR_DEVICE_BUSY
entry.description: Device is already acquired by another process

entry.name: CC_NET_STATUS_DOWN
entry.description: Interface is down or disconnected

entry.name: CC_NET_STATUS_UP
entry.description: Interface is up and running with assigned IP

entry.name: CC_NET_STATUS_CONFIGURING
entry.description: Interface is acquiring DHCP lease or configuring

enum.name: CC_SYS_STATUS
enum.description: Companion Computer health and alert bitmask

entry.name: CC_SYS_STATUS_WARNING
entry.description: System resource warning threshold reached

entry.name: CC_SYS_STATUS_CRITICAL_TEMP
entry.description: SoC temperature exceeded safety threshold (> 80°C)

entry.name: CC_SYS_STATUS_DISK_FULL
entry.description: Storage filesystem utilization > 90%

entry.name: CC_SYS_STATUS_HIGH_LOAD
entry.description: CPU load average sustained > 95%

enum.name: CC_AI_VISION_CONTROL_STATE
enum.description: Control states for Companion Computer AI vision features

entry.name: CC_AI_VISION_CONTROL_STATE_DISABLED
entry.description: Feature is disabled

entry.name: CC_AI_VISION_CONTROL_STATE_ENABLED
entry.description: Feature is enabled

entry.name: CC_CONFIG_RESULT_OK
entry.description: Operation completed successfully

entry.name: CC_CONFIG_RESULT_ACCEPTED
entry.description: Operation or transaction request accepted

entry.name: CC_CONFIG_RESULT_REJECTED
entry.description: Operation rejected due to invalid syntax or constraint

entry.name: CC_CONFIG_RESULT_TIMEOUT
entry.description: Transaction confirmation timeout expired

entry.name: CC_CONFIG_RESULT_ROLLBACK
entry.description: Rollback triggered or completed

enum.name: CC_CONFIG_APPLY_TYPE
enum.description: System action required to apply a configuration change

entry.name: CC_CONFIG_APPLY_HOT
entry.description: Applied immediately at runtime without service restart

entry.name: CC_CONFIG_APPLY_SERVICE_RESTART
entry.description: Requires specific systemd service restart

entry.name: CC_CONFIG_APPLY_NETWORK_RESTART
entry.description: Requires netplan apply and initiates 30s rollback safety timer

entry.name: CC_CONFIG_APPLY_REBOOT
entry.description: Requires reboot to reload kernel / device tree

enum.name: CC_CONFIG_STATE
enum.description: Lifecycle states of a configuration transaction

entry.name: CC_CONFIG_STATE_IDLE
entry.description: No active transaction

entry.name: CC_CONFIG_STATE_STAGING
entry.description: Transaction open, receiving staged key-value pairs

entry.name: CC_CONFIG_STATE_APPLYING
entry.description: Validating and applying configuration to Linux backends

entry.name: CC_CONFIG_STATE_WAIT_CONFIRM
entry.description: Network applied, waiting for QGC confirm packet before timeout

entry.name: CC_CONFIG_STATE_COMMITTED
entry.description: Transaction successfully confirmed and committed

entry.name: CC_CONFIG_STATE_ROLLBACK
entry.description: Rolling back to previous known-good configuration

message.name: THACO_EXTERNAL_XYZ_TRIGGER
message.description: THACO External XYZ trigger - sent immediately and retried once per second while waiting for completion
message.field: Stable per-handoff trigger ID in range 1..16777216
Timestamp in milliseconds since system boot

message.name: CC_SERIAL_LINK
message.description: One companion-computer serial link, sent at 1 Hz for each configured link. The link identity is the user-defined name (data), never a hardcoded role.
message.field: MAVLink bytes/s received on this link (router endpoint stats)
MAVLink bytes/s transmitted on this link
Kernel UART framing+overrun+parity+break errors since the previous message (wrong baud or noise)
Index of this link in the active link list (0..link_count-1)

message.name: CC_TELEMETRY_CAMERA
message.description: Companion Computer camera sensor, multi-platform RTSP endpoints (QGC, Controller, Laptop), resolution, FPS, and default profile flag.
message.field: Video stream resolution width in pixels, e.g. 1280 or 1920
Video stream resolution height in pixels, e.g. 720 or 1080
Depth stream resolution width in pixels, e.g. 640
Depth stream resolution height in pixels, e.g. 480
Encoder nominal target bitrate in kbps, e.g. 2500
Encoder maximum peak bitrate in kbps, e.g. 3000
Encoder VBV buffer size in kilobits, e.g. 1250
RTSP streaming server network port, e.g. 8554
Camera index (0: Primary / RealSense, 1: Secondary / Gimbal or FPV)
Configuration default persistence flag (1: saved as default, 0: pending/modified)
Laser projector emitter flag (0: off, 1: on)
USB bus speed mode: 1: USB 2.0, 2: USB 3.0 (SuperSpeed), 3: USB 3.2
Human-readable camera model, e.g. Intel RealSense D435i
Driver type: realsense, v4l2, siyi, csi
Hardware bus or port identifier, e.g. USB 3.2 Gen 1
RTSP URL endpoint for QGroundControl (AP subnet)
RTSP URL endpoint for Handheld Controller / SIYI link
RTSP URL endpoint for Laptop / LAN client

message.name: CC_TELEMETRY_NETWORK
message.description: Companion Computer network interfaces, Access Point (hostapd), WiFi station, and Ethernet configuration.
message.field: Hotspot uap0 total received traffic in kilobytes
Hotspot uap0 total transmitted traffic in kilobytes
WiFi client wlan0 total received traffic in kilobytes
WiFi client wlan0 total transmitted traffic in kilobytes
Ethernet eth0 total received traffic in kilobytes
Ethernet eth0 total transmitted traffic in kilobytes
Count of currently connected Wi-Fi clients
Ethernet IP configuration (1: Static IP, 0: DHCP Client)
Wi-Fi client DHCP client active flag
WiFi station received signal strength in dBm, e.g. -65
Access Point interface gateway IP (uap0), e.g. 192.168.10.1
Wi-Fi Access Point SSID, e.g. AP_DRONE
Wi-Fi AP WPA passphrase (redacted if restricted)
Hardware radio band mode, e.g. g or a

message.name: CC_TELEMETRY_VISION
message.description: Companion Computer AI perception and YOLO object detector status.
message.field: Current inference frames per second, e.g. 5.0
Model input width in pixels, e.g. 640
Model input height in pixels, e.g. 360
Current count of detected target objects
Vision pipeline status: bit 0: running, bit 1: depth enabled
Active YOLO model filename, e.g. yolo26n.pt
Input video source: rtsp, realsense, v4l2

message.name: CC_TELEMETRY_SYSTEM
message.description: Companion Computer system health, SoC temperature, CPU/RAM/Disk resources, and uptime.
message.field: System uptime since boot in seconds
CPU SoC temperature in degrees Celsius

message.name: CC_AI_VISION_CONTROL
message.description: Controls Companion Computer AI vision features from the ground control station.
message.field: Bounding box display control: 0 disabled, 1 enabled
AI target tracking control: 0 disabled, 1 enabled

message.name: CC_CONFIG_BEGIN
message.description: Initiate a new isolated staging configuration transaction.

message.name: CC_CONFIG_SET
message.description: Stage a configuration key-value update inside active transaction.

message.name: CC_CONFIG_GET
message.description: Query an active or default configuration value.

message.name: CC_CONFIG_APPLY
message.description: Trigger atomic persistence, backup, and apply to Linux backends.

message.name: CC_CONFIG_CONFIRM
message.description: Confirm connectivity after apply to disarm safety rollback timer.

message.name: CC_CONFIG_ROLLBACK
message.description: Explicitly abort active transaction or revert to previous backup.

message.name: CC_CONFIG_ACK
message.description: Structured result response from config subsystem to QGC.

message.name: CC_CONFIG_STATUS
message.description: Detailed status and progress report of active transaction.
message.field: Subsystem error code if state is error
